comparison.objective: Bread all faces of a chicken tender and place it on a rack; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated reorientation, compliant surface pressing, and minimal-grip coverage versus precise rigid-tool latch access and tensile withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Bounded bare surface area with the tender stable on the rack; candidate requires clean selective extraction, with exact damage limits missing.
comparison.reason: The physical media, contact goals, and success measures are unrelated.
